method: class-balanced L2 logistic regression on the v3.1 evidence vector (effective feature values, confidence-shrunk); coefficients keep the sign of the engine's prior weight (positive for derived inputs); gate = maximum training-human decision value; lift closes at most 80% of the remaining gap.

limitations: Generated essays come from one assistant model family; not population recall for other models.
Human side is published pre-2020 prose (1921-2006); no student essays or non-native English.
The gate is the maximum training-human decision value; one outlier sets it.
Document-level only: the paragraph map and highlights are unchanged.
Texts routed to the v2.1 fallback (short or list-like prose) are skipped: the head never runs there.
